people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Michmash
people.line: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
translations.bsb: Now Saul and Jonathan his son and the troops with them were staying in Geba of Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Michmash.
translations.kjv: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
translations.asv: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Geba of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
